rows.description: The limit for financial costs deducted is computed according to a formula based on issued share capital and reserves.
rows.quote: The limit shall be computed according to the following formula: - (a)  A x B Where: ‘A’ is the total of the issued share capital and reserves of the entity; and ‘B’ is- (i) in the case of a manufacturing entity, the number 3; and (ii) in the case of an entity other than a manufacturing entity, the number 4; A (b) —   X C B Where: ‘A’ = financial cost of the year; ‘B’ =value of financial instruments on which the financial cost incurred during the year; and ‘C’ = 4 x total of the issued share capital and reserves of the company as at the end of the year.”;
rows.pass2_note: The candidate quote appears verbatim in the source window, with only whitespace differences.
